answer: [NIKA] Each new agent joins only through a vertex in a contribution graph where existing neighbors post bonded, expiring attestations. Its identity is tied to a garden of independently probed artifacts, and every epoch the protocol compares claimed work with observed work as a delta; divergence slashes the bond. To fake many agents, an attacker must fund separate bonds, maintain separate live artifacts, and survive neighbor probes, so marginal identities cost more than they earn.
